ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Weather its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpreting? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpreting.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpreting.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Interpreting.

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transporting? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transporting.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transporting.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Transporting.

7. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

8. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Light its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Light its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Light its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Light its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Light its resources.

11. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Recording weather? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Recording weather.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Recording weather.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Recording weather.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Recording weather.

15. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

16. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain School rules and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Class Leadership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain The school and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Enterprise projects environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Initiating a class income and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for plants environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
